name: Marco Tulio
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Brazilian middleweight from Chute Boxe Diego Lima (14-3, age 32), 2-2 in the UFC: TKOs of Ihor Potieria and Tresean Gore, then a R2 knockout loss to Christian Leroy Duncan and a decision loss to Roman Kopylov (May).

how_they_fight.Striking: Aggressive puncher; ten knockouts in our data (six in R1, four in R2).

keys_to_beat: Wrestle him and drag him into R3

sources.author: Sourav Chakraborty
sources.title: 23-second UFC finisher reportedly draws Islam Dulatov in Saudi Arabia
